scripts.dev: npm run build -w @eventpass/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @eventpass/api" "npm run dev -w @eventpass/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @eventpass/shared && npm run build -w @eventpass/api && npm run build -w @eventpass/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @eventpass/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @eventpass/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @eventpass/shared && npm run db:migrate -w @eventpass/api
scripts.admin:create: npm run build -w @eventpass/shared && npm run admin:create -w @eventpass/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @eventpass/shared && npm run db:seed -w @eventpass/api
scripts.db:backup: npm run build -w @eventpass/shared && npm run db:backup -w @eventpass/api
scripts.test:pg: npm run build -w @eventpass/shared && npm run test:pg -w @eventpass/api
